“医院的事，我想跟您谈谈。任蓉蓉她想害死我，她——”

“小常已经告诉我了。”上官清越打断了他，一只手落在他肩上，轻轻拍了拍，语气温和得像在安抚一个闹脾气的孩子，却带着一股不痛不痒的距离感。

“事情复杂，涉及到你母亲……不能轻易下定论。毕竟任家在A市树大根深，不是轻易能撼动的。”

上官程心口一沉：“可是——”

“好了好了。”上官清越再次截断他的话，掌心在他肩上警告般按了按，“你身子一向就弱，经不起太大的情绪波动。现在又昏迷刚醒，不要动气。安心在家休养，余下的事交给我处理就好。”

“爸！您每次都说交给您，可结果——”

“程程啊。”上官清越收回手，目光转向门口，语气里带着一种不容置疑的、温和的结束语，“爸爸还有点事要处理，得走了。”

他说着，头也不回的朝门外走去。

“你好好休养，不要为此事劳神。”他的背影在走廊的光线中拉成一道修长的剪影，脚步没有停顿，“爸爸向你保证，要不了多久，会给你一个满意的结果的。”

门关上了。

脚步声渐行渐远，上官程心也跟着一点一点地沉了下去。

方才瞥见父亲眼中那一闪而过的心疼和愧疚，他还以为自己“大病”一场，终是换回了对方些许的父爱。以为那道冰封已久的裂缝，终于透进了一丝光。

可到头来，还是这副嘴脸。

“老大，您还好吧？”

常野从门口探进半个身子，看到上官程那张阴沉的仿佛能滴出水来的脸，小心翼翼地挪了进来。

上官程靠在床头，闭了闭眼，冷笑：“我好的不得了。这么多年，早习惯了。”

他睁开眼，目光落在天花板上那盏华丽却冰冷的水晶吊灯上。

“每次只要我向爸说起任蓉蓉或是上官淇的不好，他就是这样的态度——敷衍、搪塞、打太极。随便几句安抚、几句虚假的保证把我打发走，最终的结果就是大事化小，小事化了。”

他的声音很平静，平静得像一潭死水。

“全然不将我放在心上。一心只知道顾忌那个女人和她的儿子。”

常野咬了咬嘴唇，欲言又止，最后还是没忍住：“那这次怎么办啊？她们都已经明目张胆要您的命了，而且……父亲大人的车祸，也没几天了。”

他的声音压得很低，像是怕惊动什么。

"I want to talk to you about the hospital. Ren Rongrong wants to kill me, she-"

"Xiao Chang has already told me." Shangguan Qingyue interrupted him. He placed a hand on his shoulder and patted him gently. His tone was as gentle as if he was comforting a child having a tantrum, but with a sense of distance that was neither painful nor itchy.

"The matter is complicated and involves your mother... we can't make a conclusion easily. After all, the Ren family has deep roots in City A and cannot be easily shaken."

Shangguan Cheng's heart sank: "But -"

"Okay, okay." Shangguan Qingyue cut off his words again and pressed his palm on his shoulder in warning, "You have always been weak and cannot withstand too much emotional fluctuations. Now you have just woken up from a coma, so don't get angry. Rest at home and rest, and leave the rest to me."

"Dad! You always say I'll leave it to you, but in the end -"

"Cheng Cheng." Shangguan Qingyue retracted his hand, turned his eyes to the door, and said with an unquestionable and gentle conclusion in his tone, "Dad has something to deal with, so he has to go."

He said and walked towards the door without looking back.

"You take a good rest and don't worry about this." His back formed a slender silhouette in the light of the corridor, and his steps did not stop. "Dad promises you that it will not be long before you are given a satisfactory result."

The door is closed.

The footsteps gradually became distant, and Shangguan Chengxin also sank little by little.

Just now he caught a glimpse of the flash of distress and guilt in his father's eyes. He thought that he had a "serious illness" and finally gained some paternal love from him.I thought that the crack that had been frozen for a long time finally let in a ray of light.

But in the end, it's still the same face.

"Boss, are you okay?"

Chang Ye leaned halfway in from the door, saw Shangguan Cheng's gloomy face that seemed to be dripping with water, and moved in cautiously.

Shangguan Cheng leaned on the head of the bed, closed his eyes, and sneered: "I'm so good. I've gotten used to it after so many years."

He opened his eyes and his gaze fell on the gorgeous but cold crystal chandelier on the ceiling.

"Every time I tell my dad about something bad about Ren Rongrong or Shangguan Qi, he has the same attitude - perfunctory, prevaricating, and doing Tai Chi. He sends me away with a few words of comfort and a few false assurances. The final result is that big things are reduced to small things."

His voice was calm, as calm as a pool of stagnant water.

"You don't care about me at all. You only care about that woman and her son."

Chang Ye bit his lip and hesitated to speak, but finally couldn't hold it back: "Then what should we do this time? They have already blatantly wanted your life, and... father's car accident has only been a few days."

His voice was very low, as if he was afraid of disturbing anything.
